items.q: And Nappy LaMare and Don Owens. But, it was just a magnificent band...

ctx.x: And Nappy LaMare and Don Owens.

But, it was just a magnificent band and that was an occasion where he had that one job-- now after that, well, we had nothing; you couldn't give the band away. You just couldn't give it away. And, I told you that story aboutthe time a guy called me and said - I hear you got a good band - and where are you working - I'd like to hear you and I said - well, we're not working this week but-- I never make auditions which I haven't for years; if you want to hear the band, I'll bring it over to your club in the…
